summary: Tested centralized Approvals workflow for Website Development module. All features working correctly: LinkApprovalModal with 3 approver options (Operations/PM/CEO), ApprovalsPage with department tabs and date filters, Approve/Corrections buttons, and sequential stage workflow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Approvals workflow fully tested. LinkApprovalModal shows 3 approver options (Operations Team, Project Manager, CEO). ApprovalsPage displays pending approvals with CEO/PM/Operations badges. Sequential workflow enforces locked stages until previous stage is approved.

details: Modal opens when clicking 'Add [Stage] Link' button
Shows link input field with placeholder
Shows 3 approver options: Operations Team, Project Manager, CEO
Operations Team selected by default
Submit button disabled until link is entered
Successful submission shows toast notification
Page loads with pending approvals count
Department tabs: All, Website, Social Media, Meta Ads, SEO, Finance, HR, Business Dev, ERP
Date filter defaults to today
Search functionality available
Approval cards show: title, project name, stage, submitter, timestamp, approver badge, View Link
Approver badges display correctly: CEO (red), PM (purple), Operations (blue)
Clicking Approve shows success toast
Task removed from pending list
Pending count decrements
Opens modal with 'Request Corrections' title
Shows 'Send back to: [submitter name]'
Has textarea for correction remarks
Cancel and Send Corrections buttons work
Locked stages show 'Locked' badge
Locked tasks display 'Complete previous stage first' message
Stages unlock only after previous stage is approved
